meta.source: shadcn preset supplied by the founder on 2026-11-22, plus three canvas screens
meta.note: Token names follow shadcn, so each one is also a CSS variable of the same name.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: The page. Also the well inside a card: a code line, the sandbox log.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Headings and body text, on background and on card.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised panels: the status card, the details panel, a tinted band. Always with a border edge.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Chips, evidence lines, the track behind a seal arc, hover fill on a ghost button.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, captions, placeholders. On background, card and muted. Light is darker than the preset (0.556) so it stays above 4.5:1 on muted.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every hairline: card edges, dividers, table rules, the crosshair behind the seal. Decorative, never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: The edge of a text field. One step stronger than border.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: The 2px focus outline on every control, and the tick ring of the seal.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary action in a view (Scan, Attest) and of the closing lime band. Fill only, never text.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and rules on primary. Darker than the preset (lime-900) because that pair sits at 4.5:1 exactly in dark; this one is 7.5:1.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Fill of every other button: Open a challenge, Connect wallet, Launch app.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Lime as text or line: the word flare in the name, Sealed, passed, the seal arc, crop marks, the active tab rule. Same as primary in dark, darker in light so it reads on white.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution: the flagged state, the proxy banner edge, a broken-open seal arc. Not in the preset; added because the product has a middle verdict.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Danger: Broken, reported, a danger vote, a blocked call, the reputation penalty. Text on it is background.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The landing headline. Scales down to 44px on a phone. Two lines at most.
styles.sample: Trust the code your agent runs.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section headlines on the landing, and the Scan page title. Scales down to 38px.
styles.sample: See the evidence, not a score.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: The verdict on a target page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Step titles, card titles, list statements.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: The one sentence under a headline, in muted-foreground.
styles.sample: Scan any BNB Chain contract or AI skill.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Real people sign off on the result, one Agent ID, one vote.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Default app text: rows, tables, buttons, navigation. Weight 500 for a row title, 600 for the primary button.
styles.sample: Source code is verified on BscScan

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Ghost buttons and helper text beside a control.
styles.sample: Connect a wallet that holds an Agent ID to attest.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: The address or bundle hash that names a target page.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Addresses, hashes, counts in tables, the scan field, the sandbox log.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Lowercase section labels, state words (passed, flagged, reported), flag names, evidence lines.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Figure captions and sample-data notes. Never a sentence the user must act on.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a title and its subtitle.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between two buttons, between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside a row: state word to text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a button, vertical padding of a row.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of the actions panel and of a card section.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside a card, the gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a headline, its lead and its control.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: The page gutter on desktop. Shrinks to 20px on a phone.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Between a section headline and its content.

tokens.name: space-18
tokens.usage: Between major blocks of an app page.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Top of the Scan page, the gap between the hero text and the seal.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding of a landing section.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, fields, cards, chips, banners, state markers. The seal is the only round shape in the system, and it is drawn, not rounded.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Every border and rule.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: The active tab and nav rule, crop marks, rules on the lime band.

tokens.name: crop-mark
tokens.usage: Arm length of a crop mark.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Ghost buttons in a toolbar.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Default button height: navigation, inline actions.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons in the actions panel.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The primary action in the actions panel, tab height.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: The scan field and its button on the landing. 68px on the Scan page.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Maximum content width.
